facts.fact: 途中救援：Nikolas 背生光翼飞身抱下断梁上的男孩交还其父——民众看见他的翼与矛、哭喊他的名字；Rian 拉住他别逞强（城卫会来）。
facts.anchor: Wings of light sprouted from Nikolas’s back.

facts.fact: basilica 损毁更重：两柱倒塌、入口太阳雕塑歪斜尖芒朝下；守门卫兵（一人断臂）颤问「不会像诸神夜那样吧」。
facts.anchor: Is it—It’s not going to be like Godsnight, is it, my lords?

facts.fact: 内部：无牧师无信徒如被掏空；后殿金色太阳雕塑未倒但被一道深裂劈开（边缘焦黑如遭雷击）——Nikolas 双腿发麻仍强自登阶。
facts.anchor: A deep fissure now bisected it.

facts.fact: 阶井（王座后通往 Solara 的休眠门）：方形阶梯刻满日纹 glyph、底盆被巨石般砸碎；Rian 蹲下触碎块——「This is where it began... And where it was supposed to end」——眼瞳金光一闪即退。
facts.anchor: The basin at the bottom of the stepwell was shattered, as if a boulder had been smashed into the very center.

facts.fact: 判定：Phos 知道他们要来、先毁掉剩余的 Solara 门阻路；Rian 解释他与此地有连接又能用 quintessence——Phos 食 Orsus 之肉得 Conjuration，Julian 或是被 Orsus 警告。
facts.anchor: And had destroyed what remained of the Solara portal to hinder their chances.

facts.fact: 同一位置：Rian 指着 Taesia 剑伤处——当年诸神战 Orsus 时 Nyx 就刺过 Phos 这里、伤从未愈合；「The same spot, both caused by Nyx」。
facts.anchor: When the gods fought Orsus, Nyx stabbed Phos here. The injury never healed.

facts.fact: 兄弟争血：Rian 主张用他的血（Phos 曾说附身越久力量越相连、感染了 Orsus 魔法）；Nikolas 拒（Phos 会立刻察觉你）；Rian 掷 Lucent、又提 Taesia——「why can't you extend that same forgiveness to Taesia?」——Nikolas Lux 成刀喝止。
facts.anchor: He infected me with some of Orsus’s magic.

facts.fact: 增生物爆发：Rian 说出「有时我希望自己从未出生」——Nikolas 手臂剧痛爆出十几个白蜡增生物、想抓挠撕除；Rian 用 Lucent 结界护臂拉他出场；「Pinfeathers」——尖端已萌出白色软羽。
facts.anchor: Sometimes I wish I’d never been born.

facts.fact: 夜半疑云：矛与心跳同频发光——Nikolas 怀疑自己一直持有 Phos fulcrum 的一部分（羽毛是反噬？但父亲当年并无此症）；医师查无异常（godsblood 难辨）。
facts.anchor: Was it possible he’d been in possession of part of Phos’s fulcrum this whole time?

facts.fact: 厨房收束：Fin 替他翻正忘戴的眼罩、贴脸安「You’re all right, Sunshine」——转交 Dante 密信（Camilla 想见 Fin）；Fin 先递来一碗扁豆炖菜命 Lux 监督吃完。
